paragraphs.text:
Charlie’s fevered eyes bore into yours. Bernard’s disappearance 
has awakened a powerful terror within her. How can you get 
through to your superstitious guide?

Attempt a Regular Persuade or Hard Psychoanalysis roll (your 
choice). If you succeed, go to 522; fail, and go to 123.
